author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새 수백 마리 · 텃새 수십 마리
summary: 전국 저지대의 경작지와 초지 등에서 번식하는 흔한 텃새이자 겨울철새이다. 풀밭에 마른 풀이나 가는 뿌리로 밥그릇 모양 둥지를 틀고 알을 3~6개 낳는다. 영국에서 일본까지, 북위 30° 이북의 유럽과 아시아에 걸쳐 분포한다.

art.subject: Eurasian Skylark (Alauda arvensis), adult (sexes alike, same plumage all year), as seen on Korean lowland farmland: crown warm brown with dark streaks, raised into a short rounded crest; buff-white supercilium and pale eye-ring; cheeks brown with a darker rim; upperparts warm brown to rufous-brown, heavily streaked blackish; lesser and median coverts rufous-toned; breast buff with fine dark streaks ending fairly sharply; belly and flanks whitish; tail dark brown with white outer feathers; bill stout, pointed, horn-brown with a darker ridge; dark eye; pinkish-brown legs with a long, straight hind claw.
art.pose: standing on bare soil in a field, crest slightly raised
art.scene: Korean lowland farmland and grassland with open fields; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on bare soil with the crest slightly raised: short rounded crest, warm rufous-brown head and back heavily streaked blackish, buff supercilium, black-streaked wing feathers, buff body, pinkish legs
adult, front view standing: buff breast with fine black streaks ending above a whitish belly, short stout bill, short rounded crest
art.build: Medium-small, bulky lark, 18cm, larger and heavier than a sparrow and smaller than a starling; stands fairly upright on the ground with a short rounded crest that it raises or flattens. Bill stout and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs short-medium, pinkish-brown, with a long hind claw. Tail medium-long, slightly notched, dark with white outer feathers. In flight broad wings with a white trailing edge and white tail sides; sings while hovering high in the air.
avoid: Do not paint a long, spiky pointed crest - that is Crested Lark.
Do not paint plain, unstreaked upperparts; the head and back are heavily streaked black.
Do not omit the white outer tail feathers or paint them buff (Oriental Skylark).
Do not paint a thin bill or a bright rufous-red bird.
